description: Side project — clean B&W excavator silhouette.

frames.prompt:
A clean black silhouette of a compact mini-excavator on a pure white background. The excavator is shown in a classic side-on profile view — tracks on the ground, operator cab in the centre, hydraulic boom extended forward and bent down at the elbow with the bucket touching the ground in a digging-ready position. The silhouette is solid pure black, sharp edges, no shading, no gradients, no internal detail. The background is pure white, completely clean, no shadow underneath, no horizon line. The silhouette reads instantly as 'mini-excavator' from the boom geometry and the track shape. Centred composition with generous negative space around the machine.

[Format] 16:9 horizontal landscape.
[Style] Clean vector-style silhouette icon. Pure two-tone: solid black shape on solid white background. No greys, no colour, no text, no watermark, no shadow.
